sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Anant Kumar Mishra, Advocate

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Sangeeta Sharma, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 18-08-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, Informant and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Muffasil P.S. Case No. 275 of 2023 registered under Sections 498A, 307 and 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code lodged on 09.04.2023 by the informant, Lal Babu Sahni.
As per the prosecution story, the lady married with one Ranjan Kumar in 2022 but was tortured for dowry and on 08.04.2023, information came about her death.

It is the case of the petitioner that he is father-in-law , aged persons, living separately, nothing to do with the problem of the couple and the husband is in custody (as stated in Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.49822 of 2023(2) dt.18-08-2023 paragraph-9 of the petition).
Learned counsel for the informant submits that all of them participated in the crime and he as such opposes the prayer for bail.

Taking into account the fact that he is an aged person, husband is in custody and the petitioner is in custody since 10.04.2023 (as stated in paragraph-17 of the petition), this Court is inclined to grant Naresh Sahni vs The State Of Bihar on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168945560/
1 him privilege of bail.
